exchanges: ok so my dad put me in charge of the family reunion this summer which is wild because last time it was my aunt and she had a binder with tabs and everything and i have like a notes app
A notes app and some help can go a long way. When and where is it happening?
last weekend of july at the lake where my grandparents had their cabin its a campground now but they have a big pavilion we can rent
Going back to the old family spot gives it real meaning. Is the pavilion booked yet?
yes i put the deposit down yesterday so thats done at least
Good, the hardest thing to secure is locked in.
ok so like 120 people are coming because my dads side is filipino and my moms side is scottish and both sides have approximately one thousand cousins
That's a lively mix. Feeding and moving that many people will be the main jobs.
right so for moving people i hired a bus from the hotel to the lake and the driver is this guy david who is so nice he called me to go over the route himself
A driver who checks the route ahead is a good sign. That saves you a lot of worry on the day.
yeah and he told me he picked that route on purpose because it goes past the marsh and he spends basically every weekend birdwatching out there so he knows the roads
Ha, a driver with a scenic route built in. That's a fun detail.
lol right ok food my tito boy is going to roast a whole lechon he does it every year in his backyard and its the best thing ive ever eaten
A whole roast pig is a centrepiece in itself. Does he need anything set up at the lake for it?
he'll roast it at home and bring it in his truck the night before
That makes it easier, as long as there's a way to keep it warm.
my tita marites is making turon for dessert like a giant tray of it
Fried banana rolls for that crowd is a serious commitment. She's a hero.
then on the scottish side my sisters husband david wants to play the bagpipes when people arrive which is either amazing or terrible i cant decide
That would definitely announce the arrivals. It could be a fun nod to that side of the family.
so two davids now which is confusing my sister calls hers davey so maybe ill do that
Davey for one and David for the other should keep it straight.
my grandma lola nena is coming shes 91 and uses a walker so we need the pavilion to have a smooth path
Worth walking it yourself before the day to check for roots or gravel.
good call and my cousin fiona is bringing her new baby who i havent met yet
A new baby at a reunion always gets passed around. How old is the little one?
like three months and fiona is so nervous about bugs at the lake
Bug netting over the stroller and a shady spot near the pavilion should help a lot.
oh and i was wrong before tita marites isnt doing turon its bibingka she told me today and said turon is too much frying for that many people
Bibingka, noted. Makes sense not wanting to stand over hot oil for hours.
shes right lol
Usually the aunties are.
ok activities my uncle callum wants to do a tug of war filipinos vs scots which sounds like a recipe for injury
As long as there's grass and nobody's grandparents are pulling, it could be the highlight.
lol lola nena will want to pull
Then she gets to be the judge.
perfect shell love being in charge
Everyone wins.
my mom also wants a family tree banner where people can write their names on their branch
That's a lovely keepsake, and it helps the kids figure out who everyone is.
yes my friend jasmine who does graphic design is making it for free which is so kind of her
That's a generous friend. Make sure she gets fed well.
she absolutely will
Then you're square.
ok and last thing t-shirts. my cousin rory is ordering them, he works at a print shop in glasgow and gets a discount
A family discount on that many shirts is a nice saving. Is he shipping them over from Glasgow?
yeah hell mail them in june so they arrive in time
June leaves plenty of room before the end of July.
ok thats everything i can think of for now
You've got transport, food, activities and shirts all moving. That's most of a reunion.

questions.message: what was the bus guy into again like for fun
whats tita marites bringing for dessert
tito boys doing the lechon right
what city is rorys job in
whats fiona do for a living again
do you think i should make a group chat for everyone or will that be chaos
